text:
Ava: Quick pulse — last dry run before marketplace goes live next Wed. Need final alignment on press + partner assets. Who's running the livestream and who owns final landing CTA?
Marcus: I can run the livestream with ops. Need speaker list + run of show.
Tess: Press embargo confirmed w/ TechDaily. PR goes out 10:00 PT. Landing page needs to be live by 09:30 PT. @Marketing please confirm. :spiral_calendar:
Will: Landing copy is final, just waiting on hero image from Nimbus (hardware partner). If we don't get it, we'll swap to generic hero. @Priya any update?
Priya: Pinged Nimbus legal for approved hero asset at 11:15. They said EOD tomorrow for asset + usage terms. Also requested their short partner quote.
Marcus: Draft run of show (timings): intro 2m, product demo 8m, Nimbus partner remarks 5m, SI use-case 4m, live Q&A 10m. We need one engineer on standby for the demo cutover (can be remote).
Ava: Important: SI integration docs + webhook examples must be published before announce. @Will is the docs PR in the backlog or ready to ship?
Will: Docs PR is open: https://internal.docs/repo/pr/472 — waiting on final YAML example from eng-ml. Snippet to include in landing page: ```yaml
integration: true
callbacks:
  - webhook_url: https://hooks.partner.example/ingest
```
Tess: Reminder on timing/embargo: DO NOT distribute partner materials until 10:00 PT. If partner co-announcing, legal signoff required by 08:00 PT or we hold.
Tess: Also FYI, press wants a short embargoed media kit (1-page bullets + screenshots). Can someone assemble? :page_facing_up:
Priya: I'll assemble the kit with Nimbus assets once legal clears. If Nimbus misses EOD, we'll request a cropped product photo from their marketing CDN instead.
Will: One blocker flagged by dev: dedicated capacity for demo uses 2x A100 and quota is limited in the demo region. @devops-bot any ETA on quota bump?
devops-bot: Quota increase request submitted at 1736543300 — sandbox bump to 2 GPUs approved, production request in flight. ETA for prod approval ~1736543400. :white_check_mark:
Ava: Great. Final owners list for rollout: Press = Tess, Landing = Will, Livestream = Marcus, Partner assets = Priya, SI docs = Will. If no blockers by EOD Monday, we do a full rehearsal Tuesday 09:00 PT (dry run + failover test). :rocket:
Marcus: Adding rehearsal + run-of-show to calendar now and pinging engineers.
Tess: I'll draft the embargoed PR and share with legal for 07:30 PT signoff window.
Priya: Noted — will follow up with Nimbus contact and escalate if we don't have assets by EOD tomorrow.
Ava: Thanks team — please post any last-minute blockers here. If you see missing items, call them out ASAP so we can triage. :phone:
